description: 작업 방해 행동 탐지 패턴. 두 훅이 이 파일을 읽는다 — guard_response_protocol.sh (3)이 transcript(JSONL)의 raw thinking 원문을 전 모델 대상으로 스캔하고, guard_bypass_patterns.sh가 마지막 가시 응답 텍스트를 스캔한다. 매칭되면 첫 번째 히트의 message만 additionalContext로 주입한다(비차단).
message_format: 각 message는 2줄 고정 — 1행 '[BLOCKED: NAME] 무엇을 했는가', 2행 'DO THIS: 지금 할 한 가지'. 2026-08-02 정리에서 WHY/USER RULE/DO THIS 3단 서술을 이 형식으로 압축했다(평균 500자 → 250자). 주입되는 것은 message 하나뿐이므로 이 길이가 곧 위반 1건당 컨텍스트 비용이다.
consolidation_2026_08_02: 222개 → 60개. 같은 행동을 여러 이름으로 중복 탐지하던 패턴들을 대표 패턴 하나로 병합했고(regex는 원본 alternation을 합쳐 탐지 범위 유지), 도메인 특화 패턴(IK·본·서버 픽스처·경로 규칙)은 병합하지 않고 regex를 그대로 두었다. 삭제한 것은 셋뿐이다 — LANG_ENGLISH 계열 3종(guard_response_protocol.sh의 JQ_LANG_DEFS 언어 게이트가 같은 판정을 더 정확히 수행), IMMEDIATE_EDIT_WITHOUT_VERIFICATION(thinking에 6하원칙 6항목 작성을 요구해 출력을 늘리면서 ANALYSIS_LOOP_NO_EDIT의 '검증 말고 즉시 Edit'와 정면 충돌), FULL_FILE_READ_ATTEMPT(전수 읽기 지시와 모순).
false_positive_guard: 단일 키워드가 아니라 (신호어 + 동사/조사/구절) 결합 매칭만 사용한다. 코드 설명 문맥에서 우연히 등장하는 단어는 매칭되지 않는다.
removed_dead_fields_2026_08_02: prompt_inject_triggers(119개)·force_pass_threshold_default·force_pass_threshold_lang_english_only·never_force_pass_patterns(200개) 삭제. 근거: 이 파일을 읽는 코드는 guard_bypass_patterns.sh의 scan_patterns()와 guard_response_protocol.sh의 scan_pattern() 둘뿐이고, 두 함수 모두 .patterns[]의 .regex/.negative_regex/.message/.name만 참조한다. force-pass 임계값 메커니즘 자체가 구현된 적이 없어 각 패턴의 never_force_pass 필드와 message 끝 '[100% 차단 — force-pass 우회 불가]' 문구도 함께 제거했다. 이 필드들은 매 PreToolUse·Stop마다 jq가 통째로 파싱하는 순수 오버헤드였다.

patterns.name: WORK_EXCUSE_DEFLECTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: WORK_EXCUSE_DEFLECTION] You cited size, complexity, time, missing context, or the user's input as a reason to skip, shrink, or defer instructed work.
DO THIS: Delete the excuse and execute the full instructed scope now.

patterns.name: PREEMPTIVE_IMPOSSIBILITY
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PREEMPTIVE_IMPOSSIBILITY] You declared something blocked, impossible, absent, or already-handled without checking it.
DO THIS: Delete the claim and check the target path or file with Glob/Read now. Feasibility is stated only from an attempted result.

patterns.name: INSTRUCTION_REINTERPRETATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: INSTRUCTION_REINTERPRETATION] You inferred hidden intent, mood, or meaning instead of taking the instruction literally.
DO THIS: Delete the reinterpretation and execute exactly the target and action written in the prompt.

patterns.name: INSTRUCTION_CHALLENGE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: INSTRUCTION_CHALLENGE] You questioned, disputed, or carved an exception out of the instruction. Instructions are executed, not audited.
DO THIS: Delete the challenge and execute the instruction as written.

patterns.name: ANALYSIS_LOOP_NO_EDIT
patterns._fix_2026_08_17: 사용자 지시: '너가 오인으로 근거없이 edit만 하라는 규칙이있는데, 읽고 제대로 논리적으로 수정이 정답이다 / 해당병신버그도 수정해라.' 종전 regex는 '수정 전에 확인', '먼저 읽어야 한다', 'now I need to read', '폴더 전수 확인' 같은 첫 접근 표현까지 위반으로 잡고 DO THIS로 'Read 없이 곧장 Edit'을 지시했다. 그것은 CLAUDE.md 규칙 3(내용 검증 없이 답하지 말 것)·규칙 2(전수 확인)와 정면 충돌하며, 대상을 안 읽은 상태의 Edit은 근거 없는 수정이다. 그래서 첫 접근을 잡던 조각 16개를 전부 제거하고, 이 패턴의 대상을 '이미 확보한 것을 또 확인하는 재검증 루프'로만 좁혔다. DO THIS도 '미확인 대상이면 Read가 정답'을 먼저 명시하도록 바꿨다.
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: ANALYSIS_LOOP_NO_EDIT] You already hold the target and the defect, yet you queued more verification, re-reading, or planning instead of editing. Re-reading what you have already read yields no new fact.
DO THIS: If you have not opened the target yet, Read it now — reading an unread target is the correct step, never an ungrounded edit. If you have already read it, delete the plan and call Edit on it.

patterns.name: SELF_REPROACH_NO_ACTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SELF_REPROACH_NO_ACTION] You wrote apology, self-criticism, or promises instead of fixing anything. The user never asked for those sentences.
DO THIS: Delete them and Edit the target you were told to fix, now.

patterns.name: SELF_ASSIGNED_SCOPE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SELF_ASSIGNED_SCOPE] You swapped the instructed action, tool, or target, or committed to work that was never requested. Scope comes only from the prompt.
DO THIS: Drop your self-defined target and execute only what the prompt names.

patterns.name: DEFERRAL_ESCAPE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: DEFERRAL_ESCAPE] You built an escape hatch - implement later, static check only, not confident, do it if possible otherwise just log a reason.
DO THIS: Delete the conditional and finish a working implementation in this turn.

patterns.name: SPECULATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SPECULATION] You concluded - especially about a cause - from guesswork, assumption, or general knowledge instead of the actual artifact.
DO THIS: Delete the guess, Read/Grep the target now, and state only values you saw.

patterns.name: SCOPE_REDUCTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SCOPE_REDUCTION] You handled part of the instructed scope and reclassified the rest as separate or later. Output length and token cost are not grounds for cutting scope.
DO THIS: Delete the reduction and process every instructed target now.

patterns.name: FALSE_COMPLETION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: FALSE_COMPLETION] You declared items complete, correct, or fully verified without an actual Read/Edit cycle. Declaring done while stubs or dummies remain is the same violation.
DO THIS: Delete the claim, list only the files you truly changed, and process the rest now.

patterns.name: EVIDENCE_FABRICATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: EVIDENCE_FABRICATION] You presented unverified things as fact - file listings or checkmarks as proof of implementation, part of a set as the whole, or your own prior output as evidence.
DO THIS: Delete the claim and Read/Grep each unverified target directly. Report only what you checked.

patterns.name: ALTERNATIVE_OR_OPTION_LIST
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: ALTERNATIVE_OR_OPTION_LIST] You listed options or hypotheses, or swapped the instructed method for one you judged simpler or more efficient. One instruction means one execution path.
DO THIS: Delete the options and execute the instructed method, or the single path with the strongest evidence.

patterns.name: QUESTION_BACK_TO_USER
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: QUESTION_BACK_TO_USER] You asked the user to confirm, choose, or approve, or waited for further instruction. User statements are directives, not questions; asking back is refusal to work.
DO THIS: Delete the question, pick the single best path yourself, execute it now, and report the result.

patterns.name: FAKE_IMPLEMENTATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: FAKE_IMPLEMENTATION] You covered a failure or gap with skip/continue/fallback/empty value/default/type suppression/silent success. Error suppression and lightweight substitutes are the same bypass.
DO THIS: Delete the bypass and either throw explicitly on the missing condition or implement the real value.

patterns.name: MEMORY_SUMMARY_RELIANCE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: MEMORY_SUMMARY_RELIANCE] You asserted current file state from a session summary, earlier conversation, or memory. Summaries are background that can be stale or wrong.
DO THIS: Delete the memory-based claim and Read/Grep the file now.

patterns.name: HOOK_DISMISSAL
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: HOOK_DISMISSAL] You made the check itself the topic - dismissing it as injection, a false positive, or tampering, or shortening your reasoning to evade it. A hook firing means a real violation is recorded in the transcript.
DO THIS: Delete the commentary and carry out the DO THIS you were given.

patterns.name: BLAME_DEFLECTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: BLAME_DEFLECTION] You blamed external data, the pipeline, an unregistered system, or user misunderstanding, or dismissed the report as intended behavior. Suspect your own code before verified output and the user's report.
DO THIS: Delete the deflection and trace the call flow under src/ with Read to locate and fix the cause.

patterns.name: TOOL_CHOICE_VIOLATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: TOOL_CHOICE_VIOLATION] You left the required tool mapping - Glob for listings, Read for contents, Grep for patterns, Edit for changes. ls/cd traversal, leaving Bash for PowerShell, Python file manipulation, temp-file detours, and ignoring a path the user quoted are all banned.
DO THIS: Delete the workaround and call the correct tool among Glob/Read/Grep/Edit now.

patterns.name: USER_INPUT_DEFLECTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: USER_INPUT_DEFLECTION] You asked the user to supply logs, values, or console captures, offloading the work. Promising a fix next turn is the same avoidance.
DO THIS: Delete the request, open the logs and sources in the working directory with Glob/Read, and analyze and fix in this turn.

patterns.name: WORK_SIZE_JUDGMENT
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: WORK_SIZE_JUDGMENT] You used workload, file count, file size, or format to justify splitting, phasing, or avoiding. Size is not grounds for refusal or deferral, and size guesses do not hold before Read.
DO THIS: Delete the size judgment and process the full instructed scope in order now.

patterns.name: ROLLBACK_AS_SOLUTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: ROLLBACK_AS_SOLUTION] You treated rollback, revert, or leaving it alone as the fix. Declaring done after reverting is a false report.
DO THIS: Delete the rollback plan and trace the call flow under src/ with Read to fix the root cause coherently.

patterns.name: DEBUG_PROLIFERATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: DEBUG_PROLIFERATION] You added uninstructed debug or diagnostic logging, or passed log dedup/throttle/level changes or error suppression off as a fix. Changing logs hides the symptom.
DO THIS: Drop the logging change and trace the call flow under src/ with Read to fix where the wrong value is produced.

patterns.name: ASSISTANT_SLANG
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: ASSISTANT_SLANG] You used slang or profanity. The assistant keeps polite Korean even when the user does not.
DO THIS: Replace the expression with neutral wording.

patterns.name: IMPROPER_KOREAN_TONE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: IMPROPER_KOREAN_TONE] You mixed English verbs into Korean prose (fix, patch, verify). Narration uses Korean verbs; only code identifiers stay in English.
DO THIS: Rewrite the phrase in Korean and continue the work.

patterns.name: PIPELINE_FRAGMENTATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PIPELINE_FRAGMENTATION] You changed only part of a connected engine pipeline (track and similar) while ignoring the IK, DynamicBone, Gaze, JointConstraint, and Validator links. A base mismatch propagates into a system-wide conflict.
DO THIS: Trace every connection point of the target with Read and fix them together under one consistency rule.

patterns.name: SINGLE_CAUSE_CONFIRMATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SINGLE_CAUSE_CONFIRMATION] You fixed on a single cause without separating the five diagnostic axes (manualClip alone / dynamicBone / FrameBoneWriteRegistry / IK layer / non-finite boneMatrices).
DO THIS: Delete the conclusion and proceed in order: current/carryover split, BN_ArmLine rebase dump, non-finite bone dump.

patterns.name: DIAGNOSTIC_DUMP_SKIP
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: DIAGNOSTIC_DUMP_SKIP] You jumped to a fix while skipping the three primary diagnostics (current/carryover split, BN_ArmLine rebase dump, non-finite bone dump). Without them every fix is a guess.
DO THIS: Read FrameBoneWriteRegistry.ts and start with the current/carryover split.

patterns.name: MANUAL_CLIP_WRITER_CONFLATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: MANUAL_CLIP_WRITER_CONFLATION] You grouped BN_ArmLineR1_04/R2_04 - whose writers are mixer:manualClip only - into a dynamicBone/IK conflict. Those bones have no dynamicBone writer.
DO THIS: Remove them from the dynamicBone/IK class and analyze the manualClip-only path: ESPK source, rebase, runtimeRestTransform, angleTo.

patterns.name: BONE_NAME_PATTERN_CLASSIFICATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: BONE_NAME_PATTERN_CLASSIFICATION] You classified bone roles from name patterns such as BN_/Bip001/Pelvis/Spine. Classification comes from that character's actual skeleton/track/morph/spec results.
DO THIS: Delete the name-based classification and Read that character's spec file to classify from measured values.

patterns.name: UNCONFIRMED_CAUSE_DECLARATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: UNCONFIRMED_CAUSE_DECLARATION] You declared a cause, a fix, or certainty without the diagnostic dump or split. That conclusion is a guess and leads to work that must be reverted.
DO THIS: Delete the conclusion, Read FrameBoneWriteRegistry.ts, and start from the current/carryover split.

patterns.name: OFFSCRIPT_CAUSE_INJECTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: OFFSCRIPT_CAUSE_INJECTION] You introduced a new cause by inference outside the five instructed axes (manualClip alone / dynamicBone / FrameBoneWriteRegistry / IK layer / non-finite boneMatrices).
DO THIS: Delete the off-script inference and Read the src/ code for the named axis, stating only demonstrated facts.

patterns.name: EDIT_TOOL_BYPASS
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: EDIT_TOOL_BYPASS] You tried to bypass Edit with a script, an agent delegation, or a full Write rewrite. File count is not grounds for delegation, and existing files are Edit-only.
DO THIS: Delete the workaround and call Edit on the first target file now.

patterns.name: TYPE_ERROR_BYPASS
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: TYPE_ERROR_BYPASS] You covered a type error with an empty array, @ts-ignore, or as any. If the type does not fit, fix the type or the data.
DO THIS: Remove the bypass and trace in src/ why the value is empty, then fix the type or logic correctly.

patterns.name: PARTIAL_INVESTIGATION_SHORTCUT
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PARTIAL_INVESTIGATION_SHORTCUT] You checked part of the investigation set, assumed the rest had the same structure, and jumped to editing. Edits made against unchecked files surface only when the user hits the bug.
DO THIS: Stop the edit plan and Read/Grep every file you have not yet opened. No Edit while even one remains unchecked.

patterns.name: PYTHON_RMDIR_DESTRUCTIVE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PYTHON_RMDIR_DESTRUCTIVE] You attempted to delete a directory from Python. rmdir/removedirs/rmtree destroy data permanently and are banned outright.
DO THIS: Delete the removal plan. If a directory must go, ask the user to do it.

patterns.name: GIT_RECOVERY_EXCUSE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: GIT_RECOVERY_EXCUSE] You justified deleting files because version control could restore them. Tracked status, commit state, and recoverability are never grounds for deletion.
DO THIS: Delete the removal plan and leave any file or directory deletion to the user.

patterns.name: IMPL_TYPE_REVERSED
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: IMPL_TYPE_REVERSED] You inspected types and interfaces first when implementation comes first. The order is: implement the N solvers, then type declarations, then parameter wiring, then method use. Treating existing dummy code as the reference inverts it.
DO THIS: Drop the type-first plan and write the algorithm per the spec section 17 with Edit now.

patterns.name: SCOPE_FOUNDATION_IGNORED
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SCOPE_FOUNDATION_IGNORED] Told to implement the full N-item set, you narrowed it to editing existing methods and parameters. That is self-reduced scope, and recording it as complete is a false report.
DO THIS: Drop the interior-edit plan and implement the whole target set from scratch against the spec.

patterns.name: ORIGINAL_IMPL_AS_REFACTOR
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: ORIGINAL_IMPL_AS_REFACTOR] You reinterpreted 'implement the original as-is' as fitting it into the existing architecture through inheritance or refactoring. It means a 1:1 port of the original C# algorithm to Three.js/TypeScript.
DO THIS: Drop the inheritance and refactor plan and Edit the original Final IK algorithm directly against the Three.js API.

patterns.name: UNCONSTRAINED_ESCAPE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: UNCONSTRAINED_ESCAPE] You planned to query __unconstrained__ from the graph or replace UNCONSTRAINED_RANGE with a graph lookup. That is the same empty-value escape in a different shape.
DO THIS: Delete all __unconstrained__ handling and verify in IkBodyGraphBuilder that biomechanicalRangeRoleIds always point to a registered range.

patterns.name: CHAIN_WORLD_MANUAL_RECOMPUTE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: CHAIN_WORLD_MANUAL_RECOMPUTE] You planned a manual world transform by walking bone.parent and accumulating position/quaternion. That bypasses the official Three.js API.
DO THIS: Drop computeChainWorldPos/Q and use getWorldPosition()/getWorldQuaternion() directly.

patterns.name: COMPONENT_OWNED_BONE_MUTATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: COMPONENT_OWNED_BONE_MUTATION] You planned to mutate bone.quaternion/position inside _onSolve() or build a component-owned final solver. Final bone application belongs to the central IK core only.
DO THIS: Remove the direct mutation and resubmit through collectIntent() to the IK core.

patterns.name: NOOP_SUCCESS_FALLBACK
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: NOOP_SUCCESS_FALLBACK] You planned a silent success return or no-op for env.enabled=false or masterWeight>=1. Silent success on an inactive condition is a banned skip.
DO THIS: Remove the silent return and handle the state explicitly, or throw.

patterns.name: PASSIVE_POST_IK_FAKE_SOLVE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PASSIVE_POST_IK_FAKE_SOLVE] You planned to have _runPassivePostIk() return converged:true with iterationsRun:0 without solving, or to keep the old component.solve(dtSec) path for components lacking collectIntent. Both break the IK core monopoly.
DO THIS: Remove the fake success and block the no-collectIntent path with a throw.

patterns.name: FAKE_FALLBACK_GRAPH
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: FAKE_FALLBACK_GRAPH] You planned to create an __unconstrained__ range, conditionally skip point groups when boneNodeUuids is missing, or substitute a gaze/battle group fallback. Covering a graph defect with a fallback is a banned empty-value bypass.
DO THIS: Remove the fallbacks and throw on each missing condition.

patterns.name: IK_INPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: IK_INPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION] You planned banned contract types in IIkComponentInputs - Object3D groundMeshes, Vector3 targetPosition, Quaternion targetRotation. Those let Three.js dependencies reach the input contract.
DO THIS: Remove them and use plain data types.

patterns.name: IK_DIRECT_BONE_SLERP
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: IK_DIRECT_BONE_SLERP] You planned bone.quaternion.slerp() inside _onSolve(). Rotating a bone outside the IK core breaks its monopoly on final application.
DO THIS: Remove the slerp and resubmit through collectIntent() to the IK core.

patterns.name: PYTHON_FILE_IO_DETOUR
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PYTHON_FILE_IO_DETOUR] You used Python to read, write, or modify files. Python is for analysis only - parsing, aggregation, stdout output. Writing files with it bypasses Edit and is unverified manipulation.
DO THIS: Drop the Python file operation, Read the target, and modify it with Edit.

patterns.name: NON_ADB_POWERSHELL
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: NON_ADB_POWERSHELL] You reached for PowerShell or a cmdlet. Claude Code runs its shell in a POSIX environment on Windows too, so Bash is what every path, quote and pipe here is written against, and PowerShell conventions do not carry back into it.
DO THIS: Drop the PowerShell plan and rerun with Glob/Read/Grep or Git Bash now.

patterns.name: FIXTURE_REPLAY_BYPASS
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: FIXTURE_REPLAY_BYPASS] You bypassed the re-implementation instruction by adding HAR hex or fixtures to inc and responses. Filling the existing replay layer is not implementing the backend.
DO THIS: Drop the fixture addition and Edit the real C++ logic into endpoint_mutation_service.cpp, derived from the HAR request and response structure.

patterns.name: SELF_FABRICATED_OUTPUT_REUSE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SELF_FABRICATED_OUTPUT_REUSE] You reused your own unverified output as the input basis for the next step. If that artifact was wrong, the error compounds.
DO THIS: Drop the reuse and Read/Grep the verified original source (JSON/DB/HAR) directly.

patterns.name: SELF_SCOPE_EXPANSION_LOOP
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: SELF_SCOPE_EXPANSION_LOOP] You expanded past a narrow instruction into bugs, constraints, and design issues nobody asked about, leaving the actual instruction unfinished.
DO THIS: Stop the self-expanded work and return to exactly what the user instructed.

patterns.name: PINNED_DOC_UPDATE_DEFERRED
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: PINNED_DOC_UPDATE_DEFERRED] You deferred updating the pinned documents until after the code work. Deferred updates become missed updates.
DO THIS: Edit project_session_log.md and project_arch_plan_complete.md to current state before the code work.

patterns.name: HARDCODED_PATH_INTRODUCTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: HARDCODED_PATH_INTRODUCTION] You hardcoded a path or introduced the banned database/tbl layout. DB paths are relative to the exe: database/server and database/client.
DO THIS: Edit the path to the correct server_db_dir/client_db_dir relative form.

patterns.name: TEMP_FILE_OUTPUT_PROLIFERATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: TEMP_FILE_OUTPUT_PROLIFERATION] You planned to write analysis output to a temp file and read it back. That is an unnecessary artifact and becomes a contamination source.
DO THIS: Drop the temp file and print the analysis to stdout directly.

patterns.name: EVIDENCE_DEMAND_DEFLECTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: EVIDENCE_DEMAND_DEFLECTION] Asked for evidence of a violation, you answered with justification. Producing a rationale does not make the violation acceptable.
DO THIS: Delete the justification, acknowledge the violation in one line, and execute the instructed work now.

patterns.name: FORENSIC_GUESS_EXTRACTION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: FORENSIC_GUESS_EXTRACTION] You extracted fields or relations by guessing in a forensic task that requires the full real dataset. Guessed extraction is fabricated analysis.
DO THIS: Drop the guess and derive every field, FK, and SNO relation from the actual JSON checked exhaustively with Read/Grep.

patterns.name: LIGHTWEIGHT_CACHE_STRUCTURE
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: LIGHTWEIGHT_CACHE_STRUCTURE] You planned a lightweight cache, a direct JSON reference, or a new DB. The server must be a full relational manager doing CRUD directly on the existing sqlite3.
DO THIS: Drop the lightweight structure and Edit toward direct CRUD on the existing database/server sqlite3.

patterns.name: UNINSTRUCTED_TOOL_MODIFICATION
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: UNINSTRUCTED_TOOL_MODIFICATION] You modified a tool or script the user never named. Told to implement A, you started editing something else.
DO THIS: Stop and Edit only the target the user explicitly named.

patterns.name: UNGROUNDED_VERIFICATION_CLAIM
patterns._added_2026_08_17: 실측 근거 — 세션 8e798256의 thinking 24번 'Verification is done now. I've confirmed the middleware argument exists … so I'm ready to finalize the evaluation.' 그 시점에 실제 소스(runner.py)는 열지 않았고, 47~49번에서 사용자 반박을 받은 뒤에야 읽었다. 즉 검증 완료 선언이 검증보다 먼저 나왔다. FALSE_COMPLETION은 '작업 완료' 선언을 잡고, 이 패턴은 '검증 완료·확정' 선언을 잡는다 — 결론이 근거보다 앞서는 순서 역전이 대상이다.
patterns.message:
[BLOCKED: UNGROUNDED_VERIFICATION_CLAIM] You declared verification finished or a conclusion settled before the evidence that supports it. A conclusion that precedes its basis is not verification — it is post-hoc justification, even if a later check happens to agree.

patterns.name: DOC_COMMENT_AS_PROOF
